# War Scroll Column 17 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 17 | **Condition:** fragmentary

---

**1** In the seventh battle, God's mighty hand will overpower [Belial and al]l the angels under his command and all the men

**2** [who follow him.] [...] The holy ones will burst forth in radiance [...] pursuing [...] in total

**3** annihilation. The priests will sound the trumpets [...] and all the battle formations will spread out

**4** against them [...] and the Children of Light will blaze with the heavenly army [...] in God's truth, strengthening

**5** [...] the Children of Light. They will raise a great shout [...] and the reign of [...]

**6** will dissolve, and the angels [...] will empower [...] God's covenant [...] in the thick of battle [...]

**7** For this is the moment God has appointed to crush the ruler of the empire of evil. He will send

**8** everlasting help to His redeemed people through angelic power — He has exalted Michael's authority

**9** in everlasting light, to fill with joy Israel's covenant, with peace and blessing for God's people, to raise up

**10** Michael's authority among the heavenly beings and Israel's sovereignty over all the earth.

**11** Righteousness will celebrate in the heights, and all who belong to His truth will rejoice in eternal understanding.

**12** And you, people of His covenant, stand firm through God's testing, until He raises His hand

**13** and finishes His trials — the secret of His plans. [...] And at the destined hour He will crush forever

**14** the forces of Darkness; there will be no remnant and no survivor among the forces of

**15** Darkness. [...] The righteous will shine [...] through all the ages of

**16** eternity. [...] The rule of the Kittim will be ended, evil will be destroyed without

**17** [tra]ce, and no one among the forces of Darkness will survive [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 17 is the dramatic climax of the War Scroll — God's decisive victory in the seventh engagement. Michael is named as the angelic champion. "Children of Light" used instead of "Sons of Light" for natural English. "Kittim" preserved as the community's code name for their oppressors. "Mysteries" rendered as "secret of His plans" for accessibility.*
